lines: # The tools that build and check the plugins, set up by `uv sync --locked` from uv.lock, which holds

# before coverage keeps what it ran, so coverage starts in each process and keeps its data first.
# How much of each plugin's code the tests run, as N7 of
# dev/plugin-development-guide.md say: every line and branch.
